subject: Promo bonus landed on old workspace — request to move to new org
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@scaleup.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Credits applied to old workspace — help?

Hi Karthik,

We signed up via the self-serve flow yesterday and received the promotional onboarding bonus, thank you. I can see the 5,000 promo credits on our account but they landed on our legacy workspace (ScaleUp - staging, org id: org_44b1) instead of our new production workspace (ScaleUp - prod, org id: org_78a9). We flipped orgs when we consolidated billing last week.

I attached a screenshot of the billing page showing the balance and the promo terms PDF we used when signing up. We have a buyer demo next Wednesday and would need those credits on prod. Is it possible to move them across orgs?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Growth, ScaleUp
elena@scaleup.io

Attachments: screenshot-credit-balance.png, promo_terms.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@scaleup.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits applied to old workspace — help?

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the screenshots. Sorry for the hassle. We can usually transfer promotional credits between workspaces in the same account, but I need to confirm a couple of details with finance and CS for audit reasons.

Can you confirm:
- The exact org ids you want the credits moved from/to (you provided org_44b1 -> org_78a9 which looks right)
- That you are the admin for both orgs (or can ask the admin to approve)
- Whether this promo was claimed within 30 days of issuance (should be yes)

Looping in Laura from Customer Success to check the workspace ownership, and Rishi from Finance for the transfer. I’ll drive this through once we have approvals.

—Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

- From: ScaleUp - staging (org_44b1) — I am a co-admin on this workspace
- To: ScaleUp - prod (org_78a9) — I am the owner/admin of this workspace

We claimed the promo yesterday (within the 48h window). Demo is scheduled for 2026-03-25 11:00 PT — would really appreciate if we can move the 5,000 promo credits to prod before then.

HubSpot ref: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/scaleup (for your internal tracking)

—Elena

Thanks for the context. Finance policy for promotional credits: we can relocate credits between workspaces owned by the same customer if (1) the promo is still within the claim/validity window and (2) we have explicit admin approval from both source and destination workspace owners.

Please ask Elena (or the admin on org_44b1) to reply-all with a short approval ("I approve the transfer of 5,000 promo credits from org_44b1 to org_78a9") and include the workspace ids in the reply. Once we have that, I’ll initiate an internal transfer and produce an audit receipt.

I’ve attached an internal transfer request template for tracking: credit-transfer-request-20260322.docx. I’ll need the HubSpot company id and the reason field filled in (Karthik, can you populate?). Also cc Marissa for any exceptions — she’s our billing escalation lead.

—Rishi
Finance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
